nu_sampling: log-uniform on [0.01, 0.1]: the target is log nu, the bounds span one decade, and uniform-in-log gives every scale equal weight (matches the optimiser's parameterisation)

observation_variants.noise_def: sigma = level * RMS(clean 16x4 observations of the parent trajectory)
observation_variants.masks: nested evenly spaced (seen patterns); train-only random-dropout augmentation is a separate, documented option

normalisation: per-observation-time mean/std over available TRAIN readings only; missing readings set to 0 after standardisation (= train mean) and flagged by the mask
change_note: T4 robustness set: data simulated on 1024 cells, inversion on 256. Test split only; pre-registered in docs/preregistration_phaseF.md.
